_note: the change edits reclaimPolicy of the StorageClass, which Kubernetes refuses

packValues.name: csi-aws-ebs
packValues.values:
storageClasses:
  - name: spectro-storage-class
    isDefault: true
    volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
    reclaimPolicy: Retain
    parameters:
      type: gp3
node:
  tolerateAllTaints: false
